text.en:
Splits 50% of Damage into an Explosive Damage portion that deals 30% increased damage.
Detonation timer varies on draw and distance.

<pve [PVE] 15% Body Shot Damage Increase. Precision Damage Increase varies depending on the Precision Multiplier. />

<pvp [PVP] Total damage remains practically the same. />

enhanced (
#e Passively grants +5 Accuracy.
)
text.zh-chs:
将 50% 原伤害量，转换为爆炸伤害，该爆炸伤害提升 30% 伤害量。
引爆延迟和距离相关。

<pve [PVE] 实际增加 15% 命中身体的伤害。 精准伤害的提升量根据武器类型变化。 />

<pvp [PVP] 总伤害量不变（即只有射程上的收益）。 />

enhanced (
#e 被动提升 +5 准确性。
)

Splits off 50% of the Bow's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that deals 30% increased damage in PvE.

Payload detonation time after hitting a target or surface varies on draw and distance.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

<pve/>[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. On crits, the overall increase is 10.33% for Precision Bows and 9.69% for Lightweight Bows.

<pvp/>[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

#e Passively grants 5 Accuracy.

Splits off 50% of the Bow's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.

Payload detonation time after hitting a target or surface varies on draw and distance.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

<pve/>[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. On crits, the overall increase is 10.33% for Precision Bows and 9.69% for Lightweight Bows.

<pvp/>[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
